pr_title: Fix some older beatmaps having missing backgrounds
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/20824.

Note that this will require a reimport of beatmaps as it is baked into the database. Probably not worth making a migration for at this point in time?

issue_context.title: Background images for certain maps don't show
issue_context.body:
### Type

Cosmetic

### Bug description

Nearly identical issue as [This stable issue](https://github.com/ppy/osu-stable-issues/issues/1044)

tl;dr: The BG images don't appear anywhere(not in the menu, not while playing and not even in the editor, unlike with stable's issue) despite the .osu files having the "code" to use them and the images being in the mapset's folder.

Making this issue here as peppy wishes to handle it separately from the stable one.
